heading: Common questions
intro: The things people ask before their first session.

items.question: What is Personal Paparazzi?
items.answer: An on-demand photo and video service. Think of it like a rideshare, but for capturing memories: you open the app somewhere worth remembering, send a request, and a verified local nearby comes and takes the photos.

items.question: How do I get a free photo session?
items.answer: Download the app and request a session. Your first one is automatically free, with no promo code and no credit card required.

items.question: Which cities is Personal Paparazzi in?
items.answer: We are starting in Nashville. More cities are coming, and the app is worth having before we reach yours.

items.question: Do I need to book a photographer in advance?
items.answer: No. There is no appointment and no calendar. You request a session when you are already standing somewhere worth photographing, and it goes to every Personal Paparazzi nearby.

items.question: How much does a photo session cost?
items.answer: $19.99 for a session, which is nine photos and one short video. Your first session is free.

items.question: Does Personal Paparazzi charge a subscription or monthly fee?
items.answer: No. You only pay when you use the service. There are no required subscriptions, memberships, or recurring charges.

items.question: How do I pay for a photo session?
items.answer: After your first free session, payment is handled securely in the app. There is nothing to hand over in person.

items.question: How long does a photo session take?
items.answer: The session itself typically takes less than five minutes, from meeting your Personal Paparazzi to the last shot.

items.question: Who takes the photos?
items.answer: An enthusiastic local with a good eye and a modern phone camera. Our Personal Paparazzi are not necessarily professional photographers, and every one of them passes an identity verification before they can accept sessions.

items.question: Can I ask for particular shots?
items.answer: Yes. Say what you want in the frame before they start, and ask for another go if a shot is not right. They will take more than nine so you have a choice.

items.question: What if it rains, or I change my mind?
items.answer: You request a session when you want one, so there is nothing to cancel in advance. If the weather turns, wait and send the request later.

items.question: What do I get in a session?
items.answer: Nine photos and one short video. Each photo or video is a memory in the app, so a session is ten memories in total.

items.question: How soon do I get my photos after the session?
items.answer: The system uploads them automatically at the end of the session. You can download them to your gallery straight away.

items.question: Who owns the photos?
items.answer: You do. Photos and videos captured during a session are delivered to you through the platform, and Personal Paparazzi, Inc. retains no rights to use them for commercial purposes without your explicit consent.

pageIntro: Everything people ask about a Personal Paparazzi session, in one place. If yours is not here, the app can reach us.
